title: Compositional Loop Invariant Inference for Multiphase Programs via Structured Neurosymbolic Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2611.07882v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Loop invariants are essential for deductive program verification, yet automatically inferring them for {multiphase programs}, whose loops contain conditional branches that induce multiple execution phases with distinct behaviors, remains an open problem. Existing LLM-based methods either reason about loops as a whole or use explicit branch information to generate atomic assertions jointly across branches, without maintaining complete candidate sub-invariants for independent generation and targeted repair. We present CLOVER, a structured neurosymbolic reasoning framework for multiphase invariant inference built on two interlinked mechanisms. translated_title: 基于结构化神经符号推理的多阶段程序组合式循环不变式推断
translated_abstract: 循环不变式对于演绎程序验证至关重要，然而如何为多阶段程序自动推断循环不变式仍然是一个开放性问题。多阶段程序的循环中包含条件分支，这些分支会导致具有不同行为的多个执行阶段。现有的基于大语言模型（LLM）的方法要么将循环作为一个整体进行推理，要么利用显式的分支信息跨分支联合生成原子断言，而未能维护完整的候选子不变式以支持独立生成和针对性修复。我们提出了CLOVER，一个用于多阶段不变式推断的结构化神经符号推理框架，它建立在两个相互关联的机制之上。第一，组合式推断：CLOVER静态地将循环分解为符号化的“循环分支序列”，即刻画不同执行场景的循环守卫条件与分支条件的合取，并引导LLM为每个场景独立生成候选子不变式，从而使得……
tldr: 本文提出了CLOVER框架，通过将多阶段循环分解为符号化的分支序列、为各分支独立生成候选子不变式并进行针对性修复，实现组合式的循环不变式自动推断。
en_tdlr: CLOVER, a structured neurosymbolic framework that infers loop invariants for multiphase programs compositionally by decomposing loops into symbolic branch sequences, independently generating candidate sub-invariants for each scenario, and performing targeted repair.
